QuestInfo.name: Health Food Delivery
QuestInfo.0: Now that #p3000009# has finished making the healthy food, he asks you to deliver it to #p3001007#. Go see #p3000009# to get the food.
QuestInfo.1: You had to promise not to eat any of the health food since it's for #p3001007#. Who in the WORLD would go out of their way to eat it anyway? Take the food to #p3001007# so you can be rid of it.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the health food to #p3001007# and he scarfed it down immediately. He even asked what it was made out of. Eww...
